description: Household electricity demand in Uganda is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Geoffrey Mubiinzi. This dataset was prepared to test the hypothesis that modern energy adoption influences household electricity consumption in Uganda, but that this relationship is shaped by structural conditions such as electricity reliability, housing quality, household size, urban/rural residence, regional location, and fuel market exposure. Coverage: national (UG); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
